text: My second wife had severe convulsions after an MDMA overdose, and at the hospital they found her potassium critically low, described to me as essentially zero, and IV potassium was the only treatment they gave her. So I treat serious MDMA toxicity as a broader electrolyte emergency, potassium included, even though magnesium is still the first and most useful intervention once the jaw tenses.
reader: a friend at a festival with someone who took MDMA a few hours ago, whose jaw has started to clench and grind, with magnesium chloride flakes in their bag, reading what to do
